items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: But yeah, I loved Hank Williams. We did Hank Williams' tune, Jambalaya.

ctx.x: That gave you a special bond or not?
It probably did, yeah. Did you ever listen to Hank Williams, correct?
Sure. Hank Williams is one of my favorite songwriters and singers, oh, I love him, yes.
